# Deadwood Reblooms v1.1.2 / 枯木逢春 v1.1.2

提供 DoL **0.5.12.13** 与 **0.5.11.9** 两套构建，需使用[秋枫白桦框架 5.1.3 或更新版本](https://github.com/MaplebirchLeaf/SCML-DOL-maplebirchFramework/releases/tag/maplebirch-release-v5.1.3)。只加载对应游戏版本的主包，动态音乐音频包可选。

## 修复与调整

- 自住房家具目录对齐原版的页签、商品排版与提示，修正家具店返回位置及重复入口。
- 正式店铺、家具与健身房支持已选择的银行卡付款；街边小摊保留现金交易。拆分房产目录和证券行情，收束结算逻辑。
- 财务日志以游戏内日期和剩余天数显示维护费结算时间，分隔线统一置于尾部。
- 合并观海角与阳台的重复层级；滑翔入口放在观察外景页，支持从适合的高处前往小镇街道。
- 修正凯拉尔睡醒宏标记、游戏对白、罗宾饮品字符串、多伦代词及马蹄踢击条件。
- 丰富上学日的起床提醒，按罗宾状态与免听资格变化；自住房补充校服和课本提示。
- 调整鱼转化贴图与头像图层；马图标的毛发沿用原版发色滤镜，胡萝卜保留原色。
- 罗宾的神殿收入计入每周收入。

已完成类型、静态检查和构建打包。部分新增场景、滑翔及贴图组合仍需更多游戏内验证。

---

This release supports DoL **0.5.12.13** and **0.5.11.9**, and requires **Maplebirch Framework 5.1.3 or newer**. Install only the main package matching your game version; the dynamic music audio pack remains optional.

- Matched owned-home furniture tabs and item layout to vanilla, and fixed catalogue navigation.
- Added selected bank-card payments to formal shops, furniture and gym purchases while retaining cash for street stalls.
- Simplified property and securities code, and displayed upkeep deadlines as in-game dates with days remaining.
- Combined the sea-view alcove and balcony, and placed gliding choices inside the outdoor-view page.
- Fixed Kylar wake-up macros and dialogue, Robin drink text, Doren pronouns and the hoof-kick condition.
- Expanded school-day wake-up reminders and adjusted fish assets and hair-coloured horse icons.
- Included Robin's temple stipend in weekly income.

Types, static checks and package builds were validated. New scene, gliding and image combinations still need broader in-game testing.

Release assets are encrypted `.modpack` files, with separate optional audio packages.
